name: OpenAlex Search
label: OpenAlex - Open Scholarly Catalog
description: Searches the OpenAlex scholarly catalog at https://api.openalex.org for works and authors, or fetches one work by identifier. Purpose: paper/author discovery, citation counts, open-access URLs, and reconstructed abstracts inside a StudioQuack workflow. EXACT accepted input.action values (case-sensitive): 'search_works' (default; GET /works), 'get_work' (GET /works/{id}), 'search_authors' (GET /authors). Official docs (https://developers.openalex.org/api-reference/authentication, updated 2026-08-19): send a free api_key as api_key= or Authorization Bearer; casual keyless queries still work, a free key raises the daily budget 10×. The mailto polite pool was retired in February 2026 — OpenAlex ignores mailto= (https://developers.openalex.org/guides/deprecations); this handler sends api_key= when configured and never sends mailto. The email config param is kept for backward compatibility but is ignored. Concepts is deprecated — filter with topics/keywords. per_page is capped at 100. Default HTTP timeout is 25 seconds. Example input: {"action":"search_works","query":"large language models","per_page":25,"page":1}.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: JSON object delivered as inputVariables.input (or currentNode.inputList with targetPortValue=input). Purpose: choose the OpenAlex operation and its search/id arguments. Required by action: search_works and search_authors need query (or alias q); get_work needs work_id. Optional: filter, sort, per_page, page. Unknown action fails with output.error listing the three names. Example: {"action":"search_works","query":"CRISPR gene editing","filter":"publication_year:2024,open_access.is_oa:true","sort":"cited_by_count:desc","per_page":50,"page":1}.

schema.label: Action
schema.description: Which OpenAlex operation to run. EXACT accepted values (case-sensitive): 'search_works' | 'get_work' | 'search_authors'. Omitted, null, or blank → 'search_works'. Any other string returns output.error "Unknown action: … Use 'search_works', 'get_work', or 'search_authors'.". search_works full-text-searches works (titles/abstracts). get_work returns one work by OpenAlex ID, DOI URL, or PMID. search_authors searches authors. Example: 'search_works'.

schema.label: Query
schema.description: Full-text search string sent as OpenAlex query param `search`. Purpose: required for search_works and search_authors; ignored for get_work. Alias: `q` is used when `query` is omitted or blank (same as Python `query or q`). Accepted: any non-empty UTF-8 string; OpenAlex matches titles and abstracts. Empty/missing on search_works → error 'query is required for search_works action.'; on search_authors → 'query is required for search_authors action.'. Example: 'transformer attention is all you need'.

schema.label: Work ID
schema.description: Identifier of a single work for action=get_work. Purpose: path segment of GET /works/{work_id} (URL-encoded by the handler). EXACT accepted forms OpenAlex documents: OpenAlex work id ('W2741809807'), OpenAlex URL ('https://openalex.org/W2741809807'), DOI URL ('https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2'), or PMID ('pmid:21994122'). Required when action is get_work; ignored otherwise. Missing/blank → error 'work_id is required. Use OpenAlex ID, DOI URL, or PMID.'. Example: 'W2741809807'.

schema.label: Filter
schema.description: OpenAlex `filter` query param. Purpose: narrow search_works and search_authors (not sent for get_work). Accepted: OpenAlex filter-expression language; multiple clauses comma-separated. Common tokens: publication_year:YYYY, type:journal-article|book-chapter|proceedings-article|..., open_access.is_oa:true|false, cited_by_count:>N, authorships.institutions.country_code:US. Blank/omitted → the param is omitted. Example: 'publication_year:2024,type:journal-article,open_access.is_oa:true'.

schema.label: Sort
schema.description: OpenAlex `sort` query param for search_works only (search_authors does not send sort). Purpose: order work hits. EXACT common values: 'relevance_score:desc' (default when omitted/blank), 'cited_by_count:desc', 'cited_by_count:asc', 'publication_date:desc', 'publication_date:asc', 'publication_year:desc'. Format is field:direction. Example: 'cited_by_count:desc'.

schema.label: Per Page
schema.description: Page size for search_works and search_authors. Purpose: OpenAlex `per_page` query param. Accepted: JSON number or numeric string. Default: 50 when omitted/blank. The handler sends min(per_page, 100); OpenAlex rejects values above 100. Pair with page for offset pagination (this node does not send a cursor). Ignored by get_work. Example: 25.

schema.label: Page
schema.description: 1-based page index for search_works and search_authors. Purpose: OpenAlex `page` query param together with per_page. Accepted: JSON number or numeric string. Default: 1 when omitted/blank. OpenAlex offset pagination is limited (deep pages past ~10k hits should use cursor in a later revision — this node only sends page). Ignored by get_work. Example: 2.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Single OUTPUT port `output` (the only reply key). Purpose: success payload or failure object. Success always includes status='ok' and action. search_works adds query, total_results, works_returned, page, works[]. get_work adds work (raw OpenAlex work JSON). search_authors adds query, total_results, authors_returned, authors[]. Never contains api_key. Example success: {"status":"ok","action":"search_works","query":"CRISPR","total_results":12000,"works_returned":50,"page":1,"works":[]}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Success marker. EXACT accepted value on the happy path: 'ok'. Absent when the handler failed (failures use the error field instead of status). Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Works Returned
schema.description: Count of shaped work objects in this response (works.length), not the catalog total. Present for search_works. Accepted: integer 0–100. Example: 50.

schema.label: Total Results
schema.description: OpenAlex meta.count — total matching entities in the catalog, not this page. Present for search_works and search_authors. Accepted: non-negative integer (may exceed 10k). Example: 184320.

schema.label: Works
schema.description: Array of shaped work objects for search_works (not raw OpenAlex entities). Each object keys: openalex_id (string URL), doi (https://doi.org/ prefix stripped), title, authors[] (display names), institutions[] (unique, first 10), publication_date, publication_year (number or null), source (primary_location.source.display_name), type, cited_by_count, is_oa, oa_url, topics[] (first 5 display_name), keywords[] (first 10 display_name), abstract (reconstructed from abstract_inverted_index, max 2000 chars), referenced_works_count. Example item: {"openalex_id":"https://openalex.org/W2741809807","doi":"10.1038/nature12373","title":"A paper","authors":["Ada Lovelace"],"cited_by_count":100}.

schema.label: Authors
schema.description: Array of shaped author objects for search_authors. Each object keys: openalex_id, display_name, works_count, cited_by_count, h_index (from summary_stats.h_index), affiliations[] (first 5 institution.display_name), topics[] (first 5 display_name). Absent on search_works and get_work. Example item: {"openalex_id":"https://openalex.org/A5023888391","display_name":"Geoffrey Hinton","works_count":200,"cited_by_count":400000,"h_index":150,"affiliations":["University of Toronto"],"topics":["Artificial intelligence"]}.

configurationParameters.label: API Key (Optional)
configurationParameters.description: OpenAlex API key from https://openalex.org/settings/api. Purpose: authenticate list/search calls (recommended for any real scale; official docs last updated 2026-08-19). Type: password. EXACT accepted: a non-blank API key string, sent as the `api_key` query param. Blank/omitted: the request is unauthenticated (casual keyless budget). The deprecated email config param is ignored and is never sent as mailto=. Prefer a free api_key. Never logged or returned on output. Example: 'oa-xxxxxxxx' (placeholder — paste the real key on the instance).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for each OpenAlex GET (request timeout on the shared no-cookie client). Purpose: bound a hung api.openalex.org call. Accepted: positive number or numeric string. Default: 25. 0, negative, or blank fall back to 25. Example: 40. Keep at or below the daemon sandbox request budget so the node fails first with 'OpenAlex API Error: …' rather than the whole job being killed.
